body.name: R_1_3_legal
body.def: \(\mathcal R^{\mathrm{legal}}_{1,3}\) consists of the equations in \(G_{1,3}\), the atomic equations \(m^{S}_{j,r}=\sum_{k=0}^{3}w^{S}_{j,k}(x^{S}_{j,k})^r\), \(\sum_kw^{S}_{j,k}=1\), \(\sum_kw^{S}_{j,k}x^{S}_{j,k}=0\), and the inequalities \(w^{S}_{j,k}\ge0\), \(m^{S}_{j,2}>0\), together with the nonzero graph and saturation conditions, for both representations.
